WITH dti_groups AS (
    SELECT 
        funded_amnt,
        int_rate,
        CASE 
            WHEN dti IS NULL THEN 'NULL'
            WHEN dti < 10 THEN '<10'
            WHEN dti >= 10 AND dti < 20 THEN '10-<20'
            WHEN dti >= 20 AND dti < 30 THEN '20-<30'
            WHEN dti >= 30 THEN '30+'
        END AS dti_group
    FROM loans_fact
)
SELECT 
    dti_group,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count,
    AVG(funded_amnt) AS avg_funded_amnt,
    AVG(int_rate) AS avg_int_rate
FROM dti_groups
GROUP BY dti_group
ORDER BY 
    CASE dti_group
        WHEN '<10' THEN 1
        WHEN '10-<20' THEN 2
        WHEN '20-<30' THEN 3
        WHEN '30+' THEN 4
        WHEN 'NULL' THEN 5
    END
